scripts.start:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python api/main.py
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.crawl: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python -m crawler.multi_crawler
scripts.export: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python export_data.py
scripts.update-data: npm run crawl && npm run export && git add frontend/public/data/ && git commit -m "chore: 데이터 자동 업데이트" || echo "변경사항 없음" && git push origin main
scripts.push-data: npm run export && git add frontend/public/data/ && git commit -m "chore: 수동 데이터 업데이트" || echo "변경사항 없음" && git push origin main
